nom: First Aid Beauty Ultra Light Mineral Sunscreen with Zinc Oxide SPF 30

avis.titre: The best oily girl tinted sunscreen
avis.texte: I love this as my daily sunscreen. I am in my fifties but have a very oily t-zone. I normally only wear tinted foundation, but do not even need that with this sunscreen unless I have some redness on a given day. I do not need a moisturizer nor a primer under this, just a bit of powder on top, and I have a lot less oil breakthrough than with any other sunscreen with powder on top (or a bare face at home).

Super oily. Gritty texture. Broke me out terribly. I've used many different sunscreens over the decades . I'm 65 yrs old & have never had breakouts even as a teen. Ruined my Florida trip because I was so self conscious of how horribly it affected my skin. After 3weeks I'm still trying to heal from the damage it left on my face.

I love the formula but please release a lighter shade. This is the only mineral sunscreen I've tried that hasn't given me a breakout and doesn't pill. It's greasy at first but it gets absorbed and moisturizes my skin. Please make more shades!!!

Ok FAB, I see you!! I wear sunscreen from face to sternum every day. This one I use strictly for my face because it's tinted. I haven't worn make up over it yet, but feel it'll do well under makeup. It is a very thin liquid, and soaks in completely. I'm fair skinned and the tint worked well for me. I use the FAB ultra Repair cream as my moisturizer right now, and this works well with it. I prefer light weight SPF that doesn't feel heavy on the skin and this one fits the bill. If you're on the fence, I say give it a go. I'll def keep this one in my rotation
Best tinted sunscreen! Does not sink into wrinkles and is very light weight. I use it with my foundation and get compliments on how good my skin looks. Love it!

My favorite sunscreen hands down. Please never stop making this! I always get compliments on my skin when wearing this. I am in my mid 40's and just wear this - no foundation. No pilling. I've seen a few reviews complain of pilling - if it helps, there are a couple reasons why this may be happening....either there was not enough time between putting on products (serum, moisturizer, etc) OR the products before contain silicones. This product doesn't contain any (YAY). From experience, I've noticed that if you mix silicone products with non silicone products, pilling can be a by product. Hope this helps!

I received this as a promotion gift from First Aid Beauty. I was surprised that it really worked so well. I've been using this daily since it's tinted and worked out as a foundation too. Definitely recommend this product.

I just got this in my order and the expiration date is November 2025 and it is now July 2025. I'm sure it's a great product and everything, but I still have a couple other sunscreens to use up before I open this. Not cool, Ulta.

This is tinted but its subtle and blends well. I am a light warm olive tone and this works great for me. Its not fragrant but it does have ascent similar to the Laroche Posay tinted but thats mild and dissipates. This spf is also more hydrating than the Laroche Posay in my opinion as well as having a lighter, more neutral tint with a similar liquid consistency .I was suprised it doesn't irritate my sensitive eyes. I can use it under and over my lids and thats a big deal! My other skincare products are all FAB so it made sense to check it out! The literal only complaint i have is that it isnt water resistant. So i have to grab something else when i go on vacation, etc. this is a perfect your skin but better finish!

avis.titre: where have you been all my life!
avis.texte: I love this product so much I am literally on my fourth bottle! I've always had problems with sunscreens burning my face an eyelids however this is the only one I've ever found to not give me that problem. I like that it's a little bit tinted and makes my skin look even while providing SPF coverage. love love love

have finally found my holy grail sunscreen! It's zinc based, has no butyl salicylate, the tint is not too orange or beige, it's less drying than Australian Gold Tinted, slightly less dewy or 'wet' than Cerave Tinted. A 1/4 teaspoon initially goes on very slick feeling, but after 5 minutes it dries down considerably. I would still call it a dewy finish which my mature, dry skin needs. Sometimes I layer a moisturizer under it, some time I wear it on it's own. It doesn't emphasize my wrinkles, dry patches, or pores. It appears to give me good sun protection but I haven't tried it at the beach, and probably wouldn't since it's not waterproof. Because it's not waterproof it washes off easily with a wash cloth and Cetaphil Daily Facial Cleanser. I've tried literally dozens of zinc sunscreens and this is my favorite one.

I really wanted to like this as I am a mineral sunscreen girlie, but although initially this product felt lovely, it grew intensely drying over the course of the day. Not great for my already dry skin.
I have dry, fair, sensitive skin. This sunscreen is great. I put it on after my serum and moisturizer. I've been using it for about a year. No irritation, no sunburn. Good stuff.
I'm way too pale for this. If you're the lightest shade of foundations fair/pale you're not the target demographic

I used this product for the first time while on spring break- so my skin been dormant the last 5-6 months. I only applied once the morning and my face was the place I didn't get burt after being in the sun all day! In addition, I replyed sunscreen on my body multiple times. I will only be using this for now on!

I used this product for the first time while on spring break- so my skin been dormant the last 5-6 months. I only applied once the morning and my face was the place I didn't get burt after being in the sun all day! In addition, I replyed sunscreen on my body multiple times. I will only be using this for now on!

I used this product for the first time while on spring break- so my skin been dormant the last 5-6 months. I only applied once the morning and my face was the place I didn't get burt after being in the sun all day! In addition, I replyed sunscreen on my body multiple times. I will only be using this for now on!
Love it! My skin is dry so I mix with a little oil but it's beautiful. I have a tan complexion and don't have a white cast

avis.titre: Nice mineral sunscreen but not pregnancy safe
avis.texte: I have been on the hunt for a new mineral sunscreen while pregnant. I picked up this one in store because it looked to check all my boxes but when I went to research it more, I saw that licorice root was used and is not safe during pregnancy. If you are not pregnant and looking for a mineral sunscreen with the lighest tint and no white cast then I would recommend this for you!
I have sensitive skin and rosacea and this sunscreen has worked amazing for me! Super light weight and soaks into skin great. Wears really well for me under makeup!

I was super excited to try this sunscreen as I have always heard good things about First Aid Beauty. It didn't burn or sting, it left a slight white cast though. What I had an issue with was the pilling under the makeup. It was so bad! I returned immediately because I had to wipe all the sunscreen off just to even put concealer on.

avis.titre: Nice light coverage and doesn't burn my eyes or skin
avis.texte: I struggle to find products that my eyes or skin can tolerate. I tried this product on a whim and really like it. It mixes nicely with my weleda products I use. I like the light coverage and glow it gives my skin.

I liked the coverage and shade on my light-medium neutral skin tone. I finished the whole bottle and found it acceptable but would not repurchase for the following reasons: pills under make-up, and also did not enjoy the gritty texture felt when rubbing the product into my face.

Absolutely love this, but the spf level isnt high enough. As a white red head, sunscreen is essential for my everday skincare. I wish it was 50 spf instead, because once i apply my makeup i get worried the spf is too loq and then i get a small burn on my cheeks from the sun.

Exactly what I was looking for! I have UBER SENSITIVE SKIN that can be prone to breakouts with the majority of products. This is everything it says and more! Weightless, blends beautifully and my skin doesn't freak whatsoever! Great product line!
I love this weightless sunscreen. It's light and does not have the traditional sunscreen smell. Blends very well with make up.

omg i have been looking for a mineral sunscreen that doesnt leave me looking like a ghost (with a whitecast) forEVER!!! This is my favorite thing in the world. I use this by itself on no makeup days but it works extremely well with all of my different foundations on top!! Pls never discontinue this💕💕

I love the way this product feels and how it looks on my skin. It doesnt pill or dry out my already dry skin. However, I won't buy again because it burns if i put it anywhere near my eyes. Also washing my face with it on is a nightmare because its impossible to keep it completely away from my eyes. So, if your eyes/skin are sensitive i would stay away.

Goes on sooo oily. Shaking the bottle sounds like LIQUID because of oil!!! Pilled on my dry skin as well. Immediately sweat it off. Only giving it 2 stars because it is marginally better than their other zinc sunblock that gave me a rash.

avis.titre: IT'S SO GOOD! We need a bigger size!!
avis.texte: This is a fantastic, non greasy, non glowy sunscreen! Beautiful matte finish that goes well under makeup. I hope they introduce larger size bottles!!

I love this sunscreen. It doesn't make me oily, break out, or flare my eczema. I can easily apply the necessary amount of sunscreen without feeling like my skin is suffocating. The formula is very thin and almost feels like a serum. It absorbs within a few minutes. This sunscreen doesn't have silicones, so it will pill if worn on top of products with silicones. I've worn it with a moisturizer containing silicones and it pilled badly. I currently wear it with a silicone free moisturizer and it does not pill whatsoever. It has a beautiful tint and gives a nice, no makeup look. My skin isn't smooth at all and this sunscreen helps me feel a little bit more confident.

I am always skeptical buying tinted sunscreens because I feel like they always have too much color. This one doesn't and it has been great to use so far. It is very light and I can hardly feel it on my face. The tint doesn't do much more than add a little glow to your skin.

I love how easy it goes on my combination skin. The color blended well with my olive pink-toned skin. I do have to keep on searching though, because it's too greasy for me. I couldn't wait to wash it off. Not sure if all the facial sunscreens say you have to reapply at least every two hours but i know i can't be doing that.

I recently purchased this product because I was looking for a tinted sun screen. I tried it for 2 days and had to stop because it irritated my skin, I looked like I had a sun burn. It left my skin dry and rough.
Love this product! Blends perfectly and leaves skin silky smooth.

avis.titre: pills horrendously, tiktok lied to us
avis.texte: this was such a disappointing sunscreen. I bought this bc there were so many people on tiktok claiming it was a great product but i immediately hated it when i put it on. gave this a couple tries but each time the sunscreen smell was so strong and the sunscreen starts to pill and come off so easily. this also wears terribly under makeup - as soon as you try to put concealer over it, it pills. complete waste of money.

I was so excited to try this after seeing Angie on YouTube rave about it. It looked beautiful on her flawless skin. It is a nice, lightweight formula and covers well. Unfortunately it was too dark on my light-medium skin tone.
Very pleased with this sunscreen. I love the consistency and it blends into my skin very well. Will be a regular user.

avis.titre: My Sensitive Rosacea Skin Did Not Like
avis.texte: An influencer I follow, who does a fantastic job reviewing SPF sunscreen's that work well under makeuo recommended this one. I was trying to find a tint that worked well with my skin and while this was a good tint, the minute I started applying to my skin my skin started burning. It was also very runny. It immediately came off and went right back to Ulta.

avis.titre: Not for darker (or really pale) skin tones
avis.texte: I was really excited to try this after usikg the original formula a couple of years ago, and if you have light-medium skin this will probably work well for you. It's very dewy and unlike the original formula, it isn't grainy. However, unlike the original formula, the tint is NOT universal, like AT ALL.

avis.titre: One of my fave mineral sunscreens
avis.texte: Very lightweight and creamy. It takes about 5 min for it to dry down for me but once it does it feels like I'm wearing nothing on my skin. It may only be SPF30 but it's 22% zinc oxide which is good. Highly recommend.

I've been looking for a daily SPF to wear with acne-prone, oily/combination, and sensitive skin. I was worried that this would be too oily for me, but it's definitely not, in fact it gives my skin a really nice glow and texture.

Initial reaction…incredibly lightwieght! It felt like WATER. I am use to creamier SPF's. This is perfect under makeup, doesnt pill, nice tint, blends seamlessly. I cant claim wear since this is all an initial review. But very impressed! Wish it was higher SPF!

I've been using this for a few weeks, and it lives up to the hype! Does not break me out, blends super easily, and leaves a nice glowy finish. Doesn't have a gross sunscreen taste and doesn't hurt my eyes. I'm in love!

I've struggled to find an SPF moisturizer that gives me coverage but doesn't feel awful on my skin. Have tried SuperGoop (dried my face out and terrible white cast). Tried CeraVe and it was so oily it felt like it might drop off my face. This product is perfect. Not oily. Not drying. Tiny is barely there. It is as advertised: lightweight. I have finally found a tinted SPF moisturizer that is the right consistency and texture so that I can put the recommended amount on my face to actually get the SPF benefit. Please don't stop making this product. Would highly recommend. This is the holy grail.
No white cast. Great tint for my skin tone. Dries down pretty well. Just wish it had higher SPF but I will use this for inside days.

I bought this as an attempt to get better about wearing sunscreen daily. Unfortunately, it missed the mark for me. My product is super grainy feeling. When I apply it, it feels like I am exfoliating my face. It dries down nicely, but I can still feel the graininess on my face.

I purchased this based on a (Instagram) makeup artist's recommendation, and I am happy with the product! Perfect for summer, once you have a base tan - it is soft, very thin, and goes on nicely. If you are looking for fuller coverage, I would maybe look to something else, but for an every day tinted SPF, this would be the one!
I really love this formula because it's a mineral sunscreen that's super easy to use and doesn't give me a white-cast or break me out. It's also super lightweight and easy to remove at night.

avis.titre: Don't like sticky SPF?  This one's for you!!!
avis.texte: Honestly one of the best SPFs out there. I have oily combo skin. I HATE having sticky skin. Most SPFs leave my skin overly oily. This doesn't. It's not a full matte finish. More like a satin matte. I love this one. The tint is beautiful and blends in super easily. For more dry people, I recommend the Beekmen Milk Priming SPF drops. Nice and hydrating, not heavy.

So far, I am very happy with this product. I got it for everyday sun protection and it works great. Goes on smooth with absolutely no white cast. Provides just a bit of coverage, perfect for under makeup or use with no makeup.

avis.titre: fine coverage, but pills a ton!
avis.texte: I got this excited to try a lightweight sunscreen with a little coverage for the summer, but when I apply it it PILLS so much! I try to pat it in instead of rub to minimize this as well as waiting for 20+ mins for my moisturizer to sink in first, and it still pills. When I brush my hair out of my face and touch my skin it pills/rubs off too. Not the greatest texture.

avis.titre: Only Mineral Sunscreen I Can Use!!!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this sunscreen. I can never find mineral screens that don't leave me looking washed out, or dry my skin and feel heavy. This does not of that. It leaves just a hint of color on my skin, similar to a very light bb cream at the most, and the texture of it is so light, I have worn it on its own, and with a little lip gloss & mascara I have a simple no makeup look or under full makeup with no problems. I'm so happy to have a mineral sunscreen I can actually use! Thank you FAB for sending me this to try.
Love this mineral sunscreen. It is very lightweight and feels great on my very sensitive skin.

I love this product because it blends in so nicely. It's feels so light on the face. I love products that do not have that heavy mask feeling. A big plus it has SPF 30 and it's safe for sensitive skin!

It's really no secret that I am a huge FAB fan. Specifically this sunscreen. I love the light tint it gives my skin a nice summer glow. I love how it feels on my face lightweight and soft. There's a light scent to it which I also like because I'm usually not a fan of sunscreen scent. However, the scent does come off to me as slightly masculine but I like it.

Okay this sunscreen is so good especially when I don't want to wear any makeup. It blurs my pores a bit,slightly tinted but blends into skin well, No white cast, and doesn't pill at all. Absolutely love this new and improved mineral sunscreen. Definitely becoming a go to Product for this summer and Orlando weather.

This sunscreen is super lightweight and blends in perfectly with my skin. The tint is very subtle, which is great for days when I don't feel like wearing makeup, but it also works as a great base/primer. I haven't had any pilling with this product when wearing it underneath makeup. I also love that it doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy, which has been an issue for me with similar products. Would highly recommend!
I love this sunscreen - it is so lightweight and the tint is barely noticeable so it is perfect for day to day SPF protection. will be buying again and again!
I have been using this product for a couple of weeks now and I love it! It glides on your face easily and I like knowing I am protected from the sun. I love that I can wear it alone or under makeup!
My new favorite. So happy I bought this! This will now be a staple

Oh my gosh this is truly the best Tinted sunscreen I have ever tried and I've tried them all! It's so lightweight and adapts to my skin color and protects my face from the sun all day! You can't even tell that I am wearing makeup ! I would recommend to my family and friends and is better then all the ones out there and the best for all skin- even sensitive! Love FAB and just another amazing addition! Thank you!
this sunscreen goes on so seamless and it truly is so weightless. i put this on under my makeup and it is absolutely great! this product makes you feel like you have nothing on!
I received a sample of the product and tried it for a week. It seemed slightly tinted and evened my skin. Definitely a dewy finish! I went for a bike ride with it and didn't get a sun burn.

I have to admit, I wasn't sure I was going to like this at all, but I really do! It is a tinted moisturizer and I thought it was going to look weird, but it totally blends in with my skin. Also, I usually like a heavier moisturizer and didn't think I was going to like a "weightless" moisturizer, but it definitely does the job. I would definitely recommend this product.

I find that a lot of tinted sunscreens never look good on the skin after about an hour, but this one looks flawless for the entire day! It doesn't break me out, looks great on its own or under makeup, truly couldn't ask for a better liquid spf!

I really liked this sunscreen. It's super lightweight and goes on smoothly. The tint is really subtle - so in my day-to-day I've still been wearing makeup over it. I've used the Supergoop Glow Sunscreen in the past and think the texture of the First Aid One feels a lot better. It did make me break out a little bit in the beginning but my skin seemed to get used to the product pretty quick.

A really lightweight sunscreen great for those sweaty day and it doesn't run. Give it a good shake before using and goes on no sticky feeling and lasts till next application. I like using it as primer when I don't use foundation without spf. I wear sunscreen daily and it's really a great one to have. I was gifted for my honest opinion

I absolutely love this sunscreen. It is SOO lightweight, it feels like nothing. Doesn't make me greasy at all like sunscreens usually do. I can tell it's protecting my skin from the UV rays. Definitely love it so much.
This has such a nice silky texture that leaves you with a glowing complexion. A non-greasy feel that lays nicely under makeup. An incredible skincare staple!

This is another win from FAB! I love how lightweight and smooth this sunscreen feels on my skin. The tint is very versatile, and I love to wear it on my no makeup makeup days when I wanna skip foundation!

This is by far my new favorite mineral SPF! The finish is so beautiful and light on the skin and doesn't pill when I apply makeup over it (as long as I wait a little bit). I'm so impressed with this new release and it's 100% staying in my daily routine!
Love a lightweight moisturizer with SPF and this one is the best!

I really like this sunscreen. It's light and weightless and not greasy...which I feel like is pretty rare when it comes to sun protection. The tinted base makes it so that you don't have that annoying white film that washes you out. Definitely going to be a product i use this summer!
I use this on a daily basis and works really well under makeup. No white caste. Will definitely purchase again!

I started using this mineral sunscreen and it is now a part of my daily routine. I love how it is not sticky when applying. It is silky smooth and brightens my face with that added protection. I love it!

So far this sunscreen has been working great for me. It's super lightweight, and I appreciate that it's tinted and doesn't leave a cast on my skin. While it's quite a runny liquid, it dries really quickly so you don't have much time to rub it in. There's a very minimal sunscreen smell which is also great!

This mineral sunscreen has a sandy texture to it so it was hard to really blend in. It didn't feel moisturizing either. I think this is a pass for me. I liked the ultra repair moisturizer with SPF much better.

I found this to be a great daily sunscreen option for my dry skin. The consistency was really nice and easily spreadable on my face and it dried quickly. I love that there isn't a strong smell of sunscreen! The coverage felt great and didn't feel oily on my skin.
I love how light weight this product is. I don't feel cakey or oily after using it. It great to reapplying and not feel gluky. Definitely good on the go and compact to put in any purse.

I have very sensitive skin and eyes and there's not a lot of products that I can wear on my face specially a sunscreen. This mineral sunscreen is definitely weightless but most importantly doesn't irritate my skin or eyes!

I like that this is a mineral sunscreen. This goes on easily and not a glue like texture or oily. It makes me skin have a nice healthy glow which is good on days to the beach / pool where I dont wear makeup.

I love this product! I tested it out with a full face of makeup in the heat and was pleasantly surprised with how it sat on my face all day. I did an 8 hour wear test and I did see a little bit more oil in my t zone, but that's normal. I can't wait to use this everyday!

SO pleased with this SPF!! I'm on the fairer side but struggle to find a mineral sunscreen that doesn't have a pesky white cast — enter this baby from FAB. Added bonus, it makes my skin look polished/put together in a pinch if I don't want to wear makeup that day. Also, not issues with breakouts/clogged pores either (something I worry about with a new daily SPF). Give it a go!

I got this to try since I have had such a hard time finding a good every day sunscreen. I hate having stuff on my face that I can feel throughout the day - but this stuff is so light and soaks right in. It's awesome! Such a quality product a little goes a long way. Will be adding this to my daily routine and repurchasing. 11/10!

Weightless? I think so! After applying this product, it felt like I had nothing on my skin. It is slightly tinted but did blend into my skin without adding any pigment. I also love how small and compact the packaging is…it is perfect for throwing in your bag all summer long without taking up much space. I already know this is going to be a staple product that I use to protect my skin all summer long.

I've been using this for almost a week now and I have no complaints! This sunscreen is a lightweight tinted sunscreen, and since it was tinted I was scared that it would transfer on to my mask but I tried wearing this sunscreen with a white mask and there's no transfer! Also with that topic, the application gives a blurred effect and a slightly matte look which I really like since I wear little to no makeup. One note I have tho with the sunscreen is that, since it's a lightweight liquid, it can easily dry during application so it will only spread few amounts of product. I only need to apply more product needed for every routine but I think the bottle comes with a great amount.

At first, this sunscreen feels slightly oily when rubbing it in, but that feeling goes away almost instantly to leave a lightweight feel! I love the slight tint– although it's barely noticeable I feel like it leaves a bit of a tan glow! Also sits really nicely under makeup.

As someone with a darker complexion, I am picky about my sunscreen because a lot of them leave a white cast. Upon first swipe, I saw some white, but as I kept blending it into my skin, there was no white cast, so I was super happy! This product accurately describes itself because it is definitely feels light weight on my skin. I also appreciate that there is no strong fragrance.

So this is super watery so be very careful when using it so it doesn't drip down to your clothes or you shake or hard and didn't have the cap on right. It has that weird start off feeling of when you initially put on mineral sunscreen, but it does ease onto the skin and doesn't feel heavy. What I don't like is it doesn't easily settle and two hours layer after eating, I wipe my mouth and have wiped off the sunscreen around my mouth and cheeks if I was eating something that I feel I really need to wipe around lol. I think this could be fixed with some setting spray to sort of help keep it on. But at least I know it definitely lasted until I wiped my face!

avis.titre: Great, even if you are pale!
avis.texte: I honestly thought this was going to be too dark for me. I'm very very very fair. So glad I was wrong! It looks great on its own, and also works under my makeup! Great sun protection and fantastic texture (I forget I have it on) too! Highly recommend.
I bought this sunscreen a few weeks ago, and I am obsessed! It is so lightweight, not greasy but gives you a bit of a glowy finish. It is perfect for a daily sunscreen wear. Highly recommend!
This Mineral Sunscreen makes my skin look and feel so silky. Makes my skin skin appear smoother and softer. I love it!

I've used this product several times, and it will be my go-to product for the summer. I wear sunscreen daily, and can be prone to clogged pores from sunscreen. This product didn't clog my pores, and I was able to wear it under makeup, or without makeup.

This really says what it does. It is very light weight to the point where I sometimes forget that I even have this one! I love the no-makeup look since I have red lines and freckles. It just blends into my skin so well and easy. This product will be perfect for the summer time when you want some coverage yet breathable skin.
This sunscreen is very thin and silky. It goes on the skin very easy and absorbs quickly. It has a nice sheet effect in the skin and doesn't have the typical sunscreen smell.

Most sunscreen leave my skin looking so pale and so greasy but let me tell you girls, this tinted sunscreen blended so effortlessly into my skin and left me looking so soft and natural! I love the fact that when I put it on it was so lightweight and soft on my skin like I was wearing absolutely nothing! I will be using this ALL summer! 10/10 recommend

Beach babes, listen up! I've found the holy grail of sunscreens! As a 30-year-old beauty enthusiast, trust me; it's a game-changer. It's perfect for my acne-prone, combination skin, achieving that perfect balance without irritation. The texture is light as a cloud, soft on the skin, and not greasy at all. The cherry on top? It's luxe without breaking the bank! So def treat yourself to this fabulous sunscreen, and cheers to sun-kissed skin and endless beach days!

avis.titre: Very lightweight & comfortable! Plus NO whitecast!
avis.texte: I have super fair skin so I was nervous when I first opened this because it's tinted, and most tinted sunscreens are too dark/orange for me - however this one is perfect! It's a very light tint, it's not super pigmented, just enough so it doesn't have a whitecast and slightly evens out your skin tone. I have very sensitive skin and can only wear mineral sunscreens, I love how lightweight and comfortable this one is! Highly recommend!!

I was sent this product for my honest review. I absolutely live this new sunscreen. It's like s u p er g oo p but WAY better! No greasy residue, it's tinted so no white cast. Perfect for the no makeup days, and it gives a healthy supple glow to the skin! I'm so impressed and thrilled to add her to my skincare routine. I highly recommend 👌🏻

I had been desperately looking for a daily SPF that did not feel too heavy or greasy on my face. The Weightless Liquid Mineral Sunscreen is EXACTLY what I had been looking for! It is the perfect addition to my daily AM skincare routine, providing me with protection I need without feeling the weight of a white-casting SPF. The liquid mineral provides a beautiful finish to your routine, giving your skin a flawless, no filter needed glow!

This is a super unique sunscreen because it's the most lightweight formula I have used. I don't recommend it for people with oily skin as the formula itself feels like an oil. The tint on this is nice so there is no white cast.
This product has a nice tint to it so when I applied it to my face, it added a tinted glow to my face. It is very light once applied and protected my skin when I laid out in the sun.

avis.titre: Amazing SPF that leaves you glowing!
avis.texte: I don't typically like tinted moisturizers/SPFs, but the subtle tint with this SPF is phenomenal! I was worried about the color as the lotion is definitely darker than my skin tone, but it blended right in and just left my skin looking dewy and glowing. I don't typically wear face makeup (out of laziness), but this really gives a great "no makeup" glow. Also, I have very sensitive skin and my skin loved this product!
Perfectly lightweight, the most subtle blurring/skin coverage type of effect, no white cast! This is now on heavy rotation in my routine!

avis.titre: Weightless Liquid Mineral Sunscreen is the BEST!
avis.texte: I've been using this sunscreen for a week, it's definitely the best sunscreen FAB put out. Fab has many SPFs but this one takes the cake. Wears well alone or under makeup. No white cast feels like a moisturizer. I truly enjoy using it.

This sun screen is SUPER lightweight and feels so comfortable! It gives a blurring effect and a nice tint so it enhances your look while remaining super natural. If you want to add make up, it nicely applies over it too. Not pilly under make up and doesn't clog the pores either - very pleasant experience. Effortless summer look!

I was worried when I squirted the product out of the bottle due to the color and I'm very pale. It seamlessly blended into my skin. It layered well with my other products and definitely protected me against the sun!

I purchased this product after seeing rave reviews all over TikTok. I'm disappointed and I don't really understand the hype. I was really excited to try it but after using about 1/3 of the product I've decided to stop. It feels like there's a pieces of sand in the lotion and I don't feel comfortable using it on my face. I've tried shaking the bottle a bunch and it hasn't helped. It's also greasier than I expected. I wish I would have returned it after my first try because now it's too late.
